trial_court: Family Court, No. 1, Jaipur (D.B. Civil Misc. Appeal No. 446/2011)
facts_of_case: Husband-appellant filed an application under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act for grant of decree of divorce, which was withdrawn and another application was filed under Section 13B for divorce by mutual consent along with an application to grant exemption of six months condition.

legal_principles.principle: The court may condone delay in filing an appeal if there is no merit in the appeal and it serves no useful purpose.
legal_principles.held: We have examined the matter on merits also and in our view, there is no merit in the appeal and no useful purpose will be served in condoning the delay, but in the interest of justice, we condone the delay of 32 days in filing the appeal, subject to just exceptions.

legal_principles.principle: A consent decree of divorce cannot be passed unless a period of six months has elapsed since the filing of an application for divorce by mutual consent.
legal_principles.held: As per requirement of law, consent decree of divorce cannot be passed, unless a period of six months has elapsed since the filing of an application for divorce by mutual consent.

outcome.final_order: Delay in filing the appeal is waived. The Family Court's order dismissing the application to waive the condition of minimum six months under Section 13B(2) of the Hindu Marriage Act is set aside.
